rows.note: Rank 1 for the Echo-Lure, pheromones and Adra/Desus

rows.label: free Companion slot
rows.note: claiming the revivified Panzer needs it

conditions: A Panzer cannot be built from a Market blueprint or bought as a completed companion; Son revivifies a captured Weakened animal.

groups.activity: buy the conservation kit and one starter appearance/polarity pair
conditions: The listed standing total includes the hunt kit plus a starter Adra/Desus pair; buying both components is optional until revivification.
Higher-rank Mutagens and Antigens are appearance/resistance/polarity choices, not a requirement for a working Panzer.
bonuses: An Antigen's first polarity is effectively a free Forma slot; select one that matches the build you expect to run.

groups.activity: public Entrati bounties, then conservation at a Vulpaphyla call point

live.text: wait for Fass; Panzers do not spawn in Vome

rows.label: Weakened Panzer Vulpaphyla
rows.note: capture only after Infested damage it

conditions: Panzers spawn only during Fass. A healthy capture awards tags, not a companion input.
Use the Tranq Rifle map marker to find a Vulpaphyla call point, spend a pheromone, complete the echo-lure response, and confirm the spawned subspecies before committing.
Make local Infested hit the Panzer before calling the capture drone. Tranqing it first keeps it from fleeing while the damage condition is met.
Do not clear or hold the Infested aggro yourself: if nothing damages the animal, it will flee or despawn as a healthy capture target.
bonuses: Public Fass bounties are the low-friction route: squad activity often produces Weakened Panzers passively while you earn the standing this plan needs.
An invisible frame makes the condition easier: pull a small Infested pack to the call point, lure the animal, recloak, then let the pack land a hit.

disclosures.title: the one condition that decides the hunt
disclosures.body: A Panzer must be damaged by Infested before capture to become Weakened. That condition is invisible in the normal lure flow, which is why a normal perfect capture can repeatedly return only tags. If the spawn is Sly or Crescent, move on; if it is Panzer, tranq it, arrange one or more Infested hits, then capture it. The passive public-bounty route is usually less frustrating than trying to force this solo.

rows.label: Panzer Vulpaphyla, revivified
rows.note: Weakened Panzer + one Mutagen + one Antigen + 5,000 credits

conditions: Rank the Panzer to 30 before gilding. Gilding costs another 5,000 credits, resets rank to 0, and needs Entrati Rank 2 Acquaintance.
An ungilded rank-30 Panzer already has full combat stats; gild for mastery, customization, polarizing and reliable imprints rather than immediate power.
bonuses: Panzer Devolution lets it continue firing Viral quills in larval form for 30 seconds after going down, then reform automatically.
Son's rotating tag exchanges are the normal token source; clear them while doing conservation rather than treating gilding as part of the initial working-companion grind.
